title: Sulaymaniyah Museum

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation at the mapped footprint’s street-facing entrance approach.

mapIdentity.scope: Named OpenStreetMap relation 14585092 maps both roof polygons on Salim Street, west of the industrial high school. The archive states that the museum opened at this purpose-built site in 1980.

note: The Japanese development-agency field survey confirms one exhibition level above ground with a central hall. Director Hashim Hama Abdullah’s written history records the main hall and two sides. Exterior masonry, flat parapets, doors, sign, windows and service runs are visual estimates.
